channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israel kills turtle conservationist Mona Khalil
item.description: Turtle conservationist Mona Khalil has died after an Israeli air strike on her home near Tyre, Lebanon.

item.title: Two students arrested after three killed in Philippines school shooting
item.description: At least seven people wounded in a rare school shooting in the city of Tacloban in the central Philippines.

item.title: What are the key outcomes of the Iran-US talks in Switzerland, what next?
item.description: Experts warn unresolved questions over Lebanon could complicate efforts to secure a lasting agreement.

item.title: US, Iran agree on ‘roadmap’ towards final deal in Switzerland talks
item.description: Technical talks to continue in the resort of Burgenstock after progress on issues of Strait of Hormuz and Lebanon.

item.title: First round of US-Iran talks ends with encouraging progress, mediators say
item.description: The US-Iran talks began on Sunday in Switzerland, after last week's agreement, which includes a commitment to reach a final deal within 60 days.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill six people in Gaza including Al Jazeera cameraman, officials say
item.description: The Israeli military accused Ahmed Wishah of being a "Hamas sniper operative", without providing evidence.

item.title: Lebanese turtle conservationist Mona Khalil killed by Israeli strike
item.description: Mona Khalil, who had refused to leave the beach she had spent years protecting, died after several days in hospital, an environmental group said.

item.title: Thousands killed in US-Israeli war on Iran - but experts say true total may never be known
item.description: Experts say internet, media and government restrictions have all hampered casualty reporting across the region.

item.title: What Iran and US get from deal and why both could struggle to keep it
item.description: BBC analysts assess the claims by both Washington and Tehran to have won a victory with the deal to end their war.
